title: Tenure-Track Faculty - Fall 2027
description:
Hobart and William Smith Colleges seek to fill the following
tenure-track lines for Fall 2027. The teaching load is five courses
per year. 

Assistant Professor of
Economics 


Assistant Professor of Gender, Sexuality, and
Intersectional Justice

Visiting Assistant Professor positions are anticipated in the
following areas: Asian Studies (SWANA); English and
Creative Writing (Creative Writing); Geoscience; and Politics
(Power and Movements)
Full job posting and how to apply at 
https://www.hws.edu/offices/hr/employment-opportunities/faculty.aspx
Hobart and William Smith is a nationally recognized liberal arts
and sciences college in New York’s Finger Lakes region, enrolling
approximately 2,000 students and maintaining a 13:1 student-faculty
ratio. Known for its relationship-rich educational experience and
commitment to student success, HWS combines outstanding teaching,
engaged scholarship and meaningful mentorship to prepare graduates
for fulfilling careers and lives. One of the few undergraduate
institutions designated a Carnegie Top Research institution, HWS
offers faculty exceptional opportunities to pursue ambitious
scholarship while collaborating closely with undergraduates.
Faculty benefit from strong support for research and creative
activity, interdisciplinary collaboration, community-engaged
learning, and a vibrant academic community dedicated to innovation,
intellectual inquiry and student outcomes.
Hobart and William Smith Colleges strives for full
inclusion of diverse communities. The Colleges do not discriminate
on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, marital status,
national origin, age, disability, veteran's status, sexual
orientation, gender identity and expression or any other protected
status. EOE.
